visual.potential_relevance: Submission of an email address and registration are connected on screen to receiving the advertised high-value gift card, creating a reward/data-request relationship for review.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a free $1,000 Visa gift card and directs viewers to click a link, complete a four-question survey, provide an email address, and register to receive it. The described path also lists a shipping address, connecting personal-data submission with the advertised reward. The material does not establish who operates the destination, what the survey or registration contains, whether eligibility or fees apply, or whether any gift card was delivered.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video presents a free Visa gift card as the benefit and links obtaining it to following a link and answering a survey; the description also lists email submission and a shipping address among the steps. The closing card claims the viewer will receive the gift card, but the supplied inputs do not establish delivery.
